meta.note: v2.1: hob-level restraint with depth (a surface ladder and raised shadow), kind marks and a 28 px display title.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground: the main pane behind lists, cards and conversations. Step 2 of the surface ladder.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar and code/log wells: the lowest step, darker than the page in both themes.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised: list groups, cards, the composer, panels, dialogs and menus. Step 3, with shadow-raised.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text: inactive rows, steps, descriptions, and group labels (600).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Hints, times, placeholders, quiet counts. 5.1:1 on sidebar, 4.6:1 on selection; 5.4:1 on dark surface.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Selected sidebar row and the person's message bubble.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: The one solid button: the next decision.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: deploy.local violet: links, the brand mark, the active project name. Never a fill for buttons in the app.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Waiting on a person: the attention glyph.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Removals, failures, actions that can't be taken back.

tokens.name: kind-design
tokens.usage: Kind mark ink for a design to review: the icon in a 30 px tile. Only in Waiting on you, its sidebar rows and starting points.

tokens.name: kind-risk
tokens.usage: Kind mark ink for a risky decision on a running app: rollback, release, archive.

tokens.name: kind-proposal
tokens.usage: Kind mark ink for a proposal or idea: a feature, fix, improvement or update an agent prepared.

tokens.name: kind-learning
tokens.usage: Kind mark ink for something an agent learned and asks to keep.

tokens.name: kind-question
tokens.usage: Kind mark ink for a question an agent asked in a task.

families.sans: "Hanken Grotesk", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The title of a top-level page (Waiting on you, Projects, Live, Computers, Settings) and the new-task greeting. Once per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Detail page and dialog-sized screen titles. Top-level pages use display.

styles.name: reply
styles.usage: Agent replies: plain prose with room to read.
styles.sample: PR #17 shipped overnight. Two things need you.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: The person's messages, the composer, card titles (500).

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Sidebar rows, steps, buttons (500), lists, settings.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Times, hints, secondary lines. Group labels use ui 13 at 600 in ink-soft.

styles.name: phone-large
styles.usage: A tab's large title (.dl-ph-large): Work, Projects, Live, Computers, Settings.

styles.name: phone-sheet-title
styles.usage: The title of a sheet or detail screen's header block, as on web.

styles.name: phone-title
styles.usage: Phone top bar titles (.dl-ph-top, the iPhone navigation title); rows use the same 17 px at 400.

styles.name: phone-body
styles.sample: Roll back, then have Scout fix it.

styles.name: phone-value
styles.usage: A row's right-aligned value (.dl-ph-value), and a mono first line (15 px mono reads at the weight of 17 px text).

styles.name: phone-status
styles.usage: The label beside a status dot on iPhone (V2Status).

styles.name: phone-tab
styles.usage: Tab bar labels under their icons (.dl-tabbar), as iOS draws them. Nowhere else.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page inset; between message turns and settings sections.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, approval cards, code wells.

tokens.name: radius-composer
tokens.usage: The composer and the person's message bubble.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces on the page: list groups, cards, the composer, the risk card in Waiting on you. With a line border, never instead of it.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Selected segment, switch knob, small floating chips.

tokens.name: size-panel
tokens.usage: Right panel for a pull request or an agent tracker.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Icons in UI; 14 in steps; 18 on cards.
